0022600221.text: The Denver Nuggets (5-4, 10th in the West) visit the Memphis Grizzlies (7-3, 7th in the West) after a Denver loss, with the Nuggets 3-2 on the road and Memphis 5-0 at home... wait, Memphis is 2-3 at home and 5-0 on the road. The Nuggets lead the 2025-26 season series 3-1, have no games yet in the 2026-27 season series, and won their last regular-season meeting 136-119 in Denver. Denver will be without Julian Strawther (knee sprain), while Memphis is missing Quinten Post (head), Richie Saunders (knee surgery), and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), and Isaiah Stewart is day-to-day with a knee bruise and a game-time decision.
